notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
description:
Cast Dream's Grip by paying {U}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Orvar and Archmage Emeritus trigger.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Aquitect's Will from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Archmage Emeritus trigger, drawing Aquitect's Will from the top of your library.
Resolve Dream's Grip, untapping Mystic Sanctuary.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and the Mystic Sanctuary token by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Aquitect's Will by paying {U}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Orvar and Archmage Emeritus trigger.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Dream's Grip from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Archmage Emeritus trigger, drawing Dream's Grip from the top of your library.
Resolve Aquitect's Will, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
